authorize_workflow.contents:
# Installation proposal only. Removing this guard is a separate reviewed PR.
name: Symphony operator authorization (NOT INSTALLED)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      review_id:
        description: Independently reviewed one-run identity; never authority by itself
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: symphony-operator-authorize
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  authorize:
    if: ${{ false }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout dispatched main source without persisted credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Refuse until separately reviewed main runtime installation
        run: python3 -m automation.command_bus.symphony_operator_installation
# Activation review must bind main/event/actor/run attempt and independently
# pinned review source; same-job memory-only JWT -> exact verifier -> capability.
# id-token:write and any contents:write are intentionally NOT requested here.

candidate_workflow.contents:
# Proposed manual staging-ref route; never push/pull_request_target/workflow_run.
name: Symphony exact candidate verifier (NOT INSTALLED)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      review_id:
        description: Independent approved stage lease; input is not authority
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: symphony-operator-candidate
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  verify:
    if: ${{ false }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Refuse until reviewed immutable trusted-source runtime is installed
        run: |
          python3 -c "raise SystemExit('NOT_INSTALLED: exact source/runtime pins required')"
# Future dispatch uses ref=<approved stage>, so GitHub run.head_sha is candidate.
# Before dispatch, independent operator verifies ALL candidate bytes except the
# one artifact equal the reviewed baseline, including this YAML and all code.
# Activation adds immutable trusted main checkout/pins and the existing
# run_real_verifier_job; no candidate scripts, credentials, OIDC or write scope.
# Upload only attestation.json + operator-attestation.json; GET final ZIP digest.
